enchantment.pantheon_champions.anti_barr: Breaks Barrier Champions' shields. Deals bonus damage to Barrier Champions.
enchantment.pantheon_champions.anti_over: Suppresses Overload Champions' regeneration. Deals bonus damage and inflicts Weakness.
enchantment.pantheon_champions.anti_unst: Staggers Unstoppable Champions, interrupting their charge. Deals bonus damage and inflicts Slowness.
